notes.title: Discord’s up for Fishing Echoes
notes.content:
Hey folks—
I’ve set up a Discord server for Fishing Echoes. The game’s still in development, but if you’re curious, want to follow along, or just chat about fishing games and game dev stuff, you’re welcome to hop in.

I’ll be posting progress, asking for feedback now and then, and sharing early looks at things as they come together. If you're into behind-the-scenes stuff or just want to help shape the game a bit, this is the spot.

[b]Join here: https://discord.gg/4rSFC3WJjc[/b]

That’s it for now. 
Appreciate the support.
Sean.

notes.title: A Deeper Dive
notes.content:
We're thrilled to share some exciting developments in the world of Fishing Echoes! As we prepare for the game's release, we've been hard at work expanding the gameplay experience to offer anglers a more immersive and interactive fishing adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44584223/145d9cd0fd2e7aae7e045a16f9d46854ef58ebc2.png[/img]

One of the most significant additions is the introduction of lure-based mechanics. Each lure type will now come with its own unique set of mechanics, creating a more dynamic and engaging fishing experience. Whether you're using a classic spinner or trying out a vibrant top water lure, you'll find that every choice brings a new level of strategy to your angling endeavours.

Stay tuned for more updates as we approach the launch date. We hope to 'lure' you in with a lot more content shortly!
